keywords.indexterm: shift lever when the 12V battery is discharged

conbody.p: You cannot shift when the 12V battery is discharged.
In an emergency, follow the steps below to shift to N (Neutral) on level ground:

li.p: Connect battery cables from another vehicle or external battery to the jumpstarting terminals in the motor compartment.
With the vehicle in POWER ON position, release the parking brake.
